## Load Data

```{r}
source("~/VHH/lib/utilities.R")

pass <- read.csv("~/VHH/data/Assembled/VHH-DNA-Queries14Apr24_db-pass.tsv", sep = '\t', header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
pass$group <- "Pass"

fail <- read.csv("~/VHH/data/Assembled/VHH-DNA-Queries14Apr24_db-fail.tsv", sep = '\t', header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
fail$group <- "Fail"

dat <- rbind(pass, fail)
```


```{r}
write.csv(dat, file = "~/Downloads/VHH-DNA-Queries14Apr24_db.csv", row.names = F)
```

Note:

```
translate_DNA(substr(dat$sequence_alignment[10], 1, nchar(dat$sequence_alignment[10])-1))
QGQLVESGGGLVQAGDSLRLSCKAYGFDLDYKAIGWYRQVPGKQRESVSCLDTSEGSDDYADSVKGRFTTSRDNAKNTVYLQMNNLKPEVTGVYYCAARSSFCRILTQVDPDEGYEYDYCGQGTQVTVSS
```

```{r}
res <- vector()

for (i in 1:nrow(dat)){
    res <- c(res, translate_DNA(substr(dat$sequence_alignment[i], 1, nchar(dat$sequence_alignment[i])-1)))
}
```
